cases.sql: SELECT customer_id,CASE WHEN customer_id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM excluded_customers) THEN 'TRUE' WHEN NOT(customer_id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM excluded_customers)) THEN 'FALSE' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS predicate FROM customers ORDER BY customer_id

cases.label: 등호 비교의 세 논리값
cases.sql: SELECT order_id,coupon,CASE WHEN coupon=NULL THEN 'TRUE' WHEN NOT(coupon=NULL) THEN 'FALSE' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS predicate FROM null_orders ORDER BY order_id

cases.label: IS NULL의 판정
cases.sql: SELECT order_id,coupon,CASE WHEN coupon IS NULL THEN 'TRUE' ELSE 'FALSE' END AS predicate FROM null_orders ORDER BY order_id

cases.label: HAVING 적용 전 고객별 합계
cases.sql: SELECT customer_id,COUNT(*) AS order_count,SUM(amount) AS group_total FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY customer_id

cases.label: 고객별 일치 주문 수와 EXISTS 판정
cases.sql: SELECT c.customer_id,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id=c.customer_id) AS matching_orders,CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT NULL FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id=c.customer_id) THEN 'TRUE' ELSE 'FALSE' END AS predicate FROM customers c ORDER BY c.customer_id
